previous_description: A named collection of Permissions implementing RBAC per NIST SP 800-53 AC-2 and AC-6. Roles can inherit from parent roles (role hierarchy), accumulating permissions transitively. The level attribute defines the role privilege tier for least-privilege enforcement.
definition: A named, assignable grouping of Permissions that actors receive by being assigned to it, rather than by individual grants. It optionally inherits all permissions of a single parent role and carries a privilege tier.

distinguish_from.when: the element is the principal itself (a user, service account or external system) that holds roles, not the grouping it is assigned to.
the element is a single action-on-resource grant (e.g. 'orders:delete') rather than a named bundle of such grants.
authority is transferred from one specific actor to another, usually time-bounded or revocable, rather than held through standing role membership.
access is granted directly to a named actor on an InformationEntity under a constraint expression, with no intermediate role.

standard_reference: NIST SP 800-53 AC-3(7) Role-Based Access Control (with AC-2 and AC-6)
code_evidence: An enum, constant set or database 'roles' table of role names (e.g. ADMIN, EDITOR, VIEWER) referenced by user-to-role assignment code.
Authorization guards keyed on a role name, such as @RolesAllowed("admin"), @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"), requireRole('editor') middleware, or a route/navigation guard checking user.roles.

A configuration or manifest mapping a role name to a permission list and optional parent, e.g. roles.yaml with 'permissions:' and 'inherits:' keys, Keycloak realm/composite roles, or Kubernetes Role/ClusterRole objects.

attribute_descriptions.name: displayName
attribute_descriptions.description: Human-readable label for the role as shown in admin UIs or documentation (e.g. 'Billing Administrator'). Set it whenever the machine name differs from what users see.

attribute_descriptions.name: description
attribute_descriptions.description: Free-text statement of the role's intended responsibilities and the kind of actor expected to hold it. Set it when the purpose is not obvious from the name.

attribute_descriptions.name: level
attribute_descriptions.description: Integer privilege tier used for least-privilege comparison, where higher values denote broader privilege by convention. Set it consistently across all roles in the same SecurityModel.

notes: inheritsFrom is required, but root roles have no parent, so it should be optional. It also duplicates the role-specializes-role relationship. Three outgoing relationships to Permission (aggregates, authorizes, provides) overlap; consolidate them. The direction of level (higher means more privilege) is unspecified. Single inheritance excludes the multi-parent hierarchies common in Keycloak and LDAP.
